Cached-entry repair captures visibly show distinct sign-in, authenticator/recovery and recent-owner confirmation forms; update status identifies the current uploaded build while cached older PHP is still active, followed by a refreshed public scene.
No additional blocking visual defect identified in the representative reviewed captures.
limits: All 561 PNGs were byte-hashed and fully decoded; visual review sampled 42 captures, not every image.

Proportional complete-page thumbnails preserve the whole capture without cropping. Very long phone pages support broad layout review; detailed control geometry comes from producer assertions and original images.

Intentional unpublished-policy 404 and invalid-link screenshots are retained negative controls.
